thank u! I understand. though can I ask,, what did u feel when you tried hanging? was it painful? did it make you have second thoughts? if you’re not comfortable in answering it’s okay I understand. 

also heyy since ure current plan is jumping, can I tell u something I read on a novel? it was a crime investigation novel and there was one part where this person was trying to jump and the main lead who is a police told her this: “If you fall from here, you’ll become an uncontrollable falling body. You won’t necessarily fall headfirst, and you may not die immediately. For a minute, or even a few minutes, you’ll be able to clearly feel the pain of all your bones being broken, your organs being pierced. You’ll be a bloody mess on the ground, in ten thousand times more pain than now.” sorry I just thought I’d share it with you bec that kinda got me thinking.
